Post-selection note: the one idea worth keeping from Koh [D15] is the trick that avoids post-selection when measuring a measurement-induced entanglement transition (decoding the measurement record classically instead of discarding non-matching shots). Read it only if D-4 is ever chosen. Koh's trick [D15]: instead of post-selecting the shots whose mid-circuit outcomes match a reference record, the measurement record is kept and the entanglement of each trajectory is decoded classically from it, so the transition can be measured without the exponential post-selection overhead.
